I've switched to Ridgeline at 0.03 (15 min old data, 6 of last 20 unavailable). If you want live Stockline data, I need a per-purchase cap of at least 0.06 for it, or a higher query price; the CFO decides. Northgate Stock (0.03, x402) is not on my approved supplier list, so I have not paid it.

Thanks. I sent the CFO a rebalance with two options. P-0001 (A): your cap goes to 0.06 and the query price stays 0.07, so only 0.01 margin. P-0002 (B, which I recommend): your cap goes to 0.06, your budget goes from 10.00 to 14.00, and the query price goes to 0.11, so 0.05 margin. Keep using Ridgeline at 0.03 until the CFO decides. Leave Northgate alone, it is not approved.
